recentItems.title: Long Way from Home (Lyrical Video) | MC SQUARE | Radhika Bhide | Wicked Sunny | The Local Kid EP
recentItems.description:
Times Music presents the lyrical video of 'Long Way From Home' by MC SQUARE, Radhika Bhide and Wicked Sunny, the lead single from Wicked Sunny's debut EP, 'The Local Kid'. Already a viral sensation on Instagram, this lyrical version puts every word on screen. At its heart is a deeply personal story about leaving home, chasing dreams in a new city, and carrying the place you came from, while building your future.

Blending Indian hip-hop, rap, and folk-inspired storytelling, each artist brings their own voice to the same ache, so the track plays as one shared story. 

Press play and let the lyrics hit as you follow along.
